author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೀಗಿನೀ ನಡೆಯದಿರು ಯಾರೊ ಹೊಗಳಿದರೆಂದು
ನೀಗಿನಡೆ ಸೊಕ್ಕಿರುವ ಮಮಕಾರಗಳನು
ಸಾಗುತಿರೆ ನಿನಬದುಕು ಹೊಗಳುತೆಗಳಿಕೆಯೊಡನೆ
ಬಾಗಿನಡೆ ನಿಸ್ಪೃಹದಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t strut because someone praised you;
walk on, shedding the arrogant attachments;
as your life moves on with praise and blame,
walk bowed and free of desire, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Praise should not go to our heads. Let go of pride, accept both praise and criticism as part of life, and walk humbly.
